name: Torre-Pacheco (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torre-Pacheco (a tower above waves on blue and cauldrons on red).
history: Municipal flag of Torre-Pacheco; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Torre-Pacheco arms — tower above waves on blue and cauldrons on red
